item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Bowen: Strait of Hormuz standoff raises risk of sliding back into all-out war
item.description: The US and Iran's determination to keep the pressure on each other has put the fragile Gulf ceasefire in serious jeopardy.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.

item.title: What Israel wants from an Iran peace deal: No enrichment, missile limits and strict enforcement
item.description: Israel wants Iran to stop enrichment, dismantle underground nuclear sites, restrict missiles and cut ties to Hamas and Hezbollah, experts say.

item.title: Trump's hopes for an Iran peace deal come with caveats
item.description: There are signs of fresh momentum to end the war, but Trump himself has injected a note of caution.

item.title: Iran Says It Is Reviewing a U.S. Proposal to End the War
item.description: Nothing was disclosed about the peace plan, and there were conflicting signals from the Iranians about how seriously they were taking it.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: No details have been released of Iran's response - or the US proposals - designed to bring the war to an end.

item.title: Mass Layoffs in Iran as Businesses Buckle Under Wartime Pressures
item.description: Iran was already struggling economically before 2026 brought widespread instability. A government-imposed internet shutdown has crippled an entire sector.

item.title: Iran war is crushing Asia’s farmers, threatening global food supply
item.description: High prices of fuel, fertilizer and other essentials are forcing farmers in Thailand and elsewhere to skip a planting season to avoid losing money on their harvests.

item.title: Trump ‘right to be outraged’ by Europe’s betrayal on Iran, says former Thatcher advisor
item.description: President Trump is putting Europe on notice, vowing the U.S. will remember the lack of support during the Iran war as Germany, Italy, Spain and others put on warning.
